observed_manual_blockers: Initial JOIN_ACK ItemGraph had inventories:{}; starter items appeared only after first item command.
Valid-looking inventory/container interaction later produced SOURCE_CONTAINER_ACCESS_DENIED after authority/presentation diverged.
Client health reported MULTIPLAYER_SAME_REVISION_MUTATION during fixed-tick snapshot traffic.
Prediction history_miss_resets increased after the item/snapshot divergence.
root_causes: Canonical sandbox player inventory was materialized lazily by the first item command instead of before JOIN_ACK.
Player materialization mutated canonical ItemGraph content without advancing ItemGraph revision/tick.

Full and compact gameplay snapshots on independent channels could carry the same semantic revision at different server ticks; strict checksum-only same-revision handling misclassified clock reordering as mutation.

M7 playground presentation deduped ItemGraph updates only by canonical revision, so an NX6 optimistic projection and its rollback/rebase at the same revision could not both reach ItemGameplayController.
changes: Dedicated M7 server materializes canonical player item inventory after successful gameplay JOIN and before durable commit/JOIN_ACK.
Canonical player materialization advances ItemGraph revision/tick exactly once and is idempotent on replay.

Graphical client treats same-revision snapshots as clock-only only when owner, epoch, revision, players and shared state are semantically identical; newer clock reconciles, older clock is superseded replay.
M7 playground applies item presentation changes by full projection hash rather than revision alone, preserving same-revision prediction rollback/rebase.
Focused Windows runner validates editor parse, join materialization semantics, bidirectional clock-only comparison and the existing NX6 predicted-item suite.
unchanged_contracts: No weakening of true same-revision semantic mutation rejection.
No client-side invention of authoritative starter items.
No persistence requirement for the realtime debug server.
required_focused_gate: VALIDATE_M7_NETWORK_ITEM_REPLICA.ps1 must PASS on the exact candidate.
Initial inventory must show starter battery/beacons/mount-bases before any pickup.
Open container, transfer battery inventory->container and container->inventory repeatedly.
No SOURCE_CONTAINER_ACCESS_DENIED for a valid currently-open source/target container path.
No MULTIPLAYER_SAME_REVISION_MUTATION for clock-only snapshot reordering.
No visible freeze; prediction lead/history must recover without history_miss_resets growth attributable to item interaction.
